items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: Well I do a lot of work with Egan, But we do like it’s New York at the 55 Bar with Jeff Champlin, it’s almost like a Scofieldish, Methaneyish trio.

ctx.x: Yeah, how’s that? Well I do a lot of work with Egan, But we do like it’s New York at the 55 Bar with Jeff Champlin, it’s almost like a Scofieldish, Methaneyish trio. Almost power jazz trios. Pseudo — I don’t know what to call it. But we play together. So I got to be good friends with Mark and it’s a real treat to play with him and Jeff. And then we play together with Vignola, and did a record with Frank Wess. And I wrote three tunes for this one record, because I was hearing him playing the flute on these tunes.…
Cool. I see you’ve worked with Sweets Edison too.
